name: Demo — NotPetya Global Outbreak
description: Demo scenario inspired by the publicly documented 2017 NotPetya destructive outbreak. It adds contextual reconnaissance and supply-chain staging for a rich matrix and is not an authoritative incident reconstruction.

layers.name: Supply-Chain Targeting
layers.description: Research victim software environments and prepare a compromised software distribution path capable of reaching many organizations.

layers.name: Initial Endpoint
layers.description: Execute the staged payload, inspect host defenses and files, and prepare credentials and reboot behavior for propagation.

layers.name: Enterprise Network
layers.description: Spread using SMB exploitation, valid local credentials, administrative shares, WMI, and remote service execution.

layers.name: Business Operations
layers.description: Clear evidence, encrypt data and disk structures, force reboots, and cause broad loss of availability and productivity.
